plain_text:
Defence follows DEFRA’s GGCs, with targets set for 2020-2025. Progress against these
targets is detailed within the sustainability section above. As part of the GCC targets,
Defence is also developing a departmental adaptation plan. Additionally, each Defence
establishment must conduct a climate impact risk assessment every 5 years. The
assessments are used to inform the Estate Climate Resilience Plan.
